display_name: "Muse" -- RESOLVED: Muse-Glimmer, and it is not an audio model
description: The task list named MUSE alongside TTS / PARAKEET / SPEECH / Qwen3-ASR. Resolved on 2026-08-31 by parsing upstream llama.cpp's mtmd projector enum rather than by guessing from the name.

resolution.answer: Muse-Glimmer-30B, a multimodal vision-language model. Upstream llama.cpp carries it as PROJECTOR_TYPE_MUSE_GLIMMER / "muse-glimmer" in examples/mtmd/clip-impl.h (line 502 and 566 of the upstream-mtmd-catchup worktree).
evidence: upstream enum parsed at tmp/wt_mtmd/examples/mtmd/clip-impl.h:502,566 -- control PROJECTOR_TYPE_MLP present in the same sweep
Hugging Face search: meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B and unsloth/Muse-Glimmer-30B-GGUF, ~1.5M combined downloads, pipeline_tag=image-text-to-text
the sibling asr_agent independently classified MUSE_GLIMMER as NOT audio-input
resolution.verdict: It is a VISION projector. It belongs to the mtmd upstream-catchup workstream, not to llama-audio. Nothing for the audio pipeline to implement.
